question: How far can event commitment be delayed before unguided joint generation degrades?
motivation: geolead-1: t_b = s^2 and s^3 opened the xTB window to 27.9% and 34.6% at small quality cost; this extends the dose-response
reused_definitions: everything in geolead-1 (configs/explore/geometry_lead.json): rows, signals, t_geo, window_fraction and the 0.20 threshold, quality metrics and V1a tolerances, readings
data_scope: V1a development parents only (62 parents, 21 formula groups)

paths.sync: t_b = s, t_x = s (geolead-1 rows, identical to check B)
paths.geometry_lead3: t_b = s^3, t_x = s (rerun under the recorded rollout)
paths.event_delay30: t_b = 0 until s = 0.3, then linear to 1; t_x = s
paths.event_delay50: t_b = 0 until s = 0.5, then linear to 1; t_x = s

rollout: xtbflow.v1.explore_rollout.recorded_rollout without push; endpoint predictions from the network's velocity, so b1_hat is defined while t_b is held at 0 (it then conditions on the evolving geometry)

reading.GEOMETRY_LEAD_OPENS_WINDOW: xTB window_fraction >= 0.20 and both quality drops within tolerance
reading.WINDOW_WITH_QUALITY_LOSS: xTB window_fraction >= 0.20 but a quality drop exceeds tolerance
reading.NO_USABLE_WINDOW: xTB window_fraction < 0.20, or the xTB signal is never informative
reading.per_path: every path gets its own reading; none is chosen by its result here

quality.comparison: path - sync, paired by parent, formula-cluster t two-sided 95%
quality.tolerance: hits_best_reference drop <= 0.05 and valid-rate drop <= 0.10 (point estimates)
